description: Validated reusable production lessons only. Do not store unverified assumptions as lessons.

lessons.problem: Characters animated with static kit poses (40/64 acts), planner 2-frame walks and glides: mechanical, rigid, sliding.
lessons.root_cause: acts authored with blocking poses (stand, knock, hold_up...) and walk=True; film.json had no tween, so poses snapped; motion polish (breath/blink) only runs on library moves
lessons.fix: every act is a registered m:<id> library move; position changes use m:walk/run/bike with linear travel at real speeds; tween {ones:true, face_frames:0, move_blend:6}; new moves are registered in templates/motion_styles/library.mjs; gate D runs tools/anim_audit.py

tests: tools/tests/test_production_intelligence.py :: PI-001 anim_audit FAILs the v1 film
tools/tests/test_production_intelligence.py :: PI-001 anim_audit PASSes the current film
verification.regression_check: anim_audit on the v1 film.json (git c3937a0) reports STATIC 37 -> FAIL; current film PASS

lessons.problem: Effects silently disappeared (shell bursts, river moonlight, a fade) although node --check passed and the film rendered.
lessons.root_cause: an inline // note written after code on a long one-line statement swallowed the rest of the line
lessons.fix: inline notes use /* */; tools/lint_set_modules.py flags a // that follows code and is followed by code; gate E runs it on every episode set module

tests: tools/tests/test_production_intelligence.py :: PI-002 Ghost Army set module is clean
verification.regression_check: the lint flags the bug in git history (commits 63d3a57, 6759b96) and 3/3 fixture lines, 0 false positives on the 2 clean fixture lines and on the current set

lessons.problem: A character entering a new place slid for 0.5 s from its old coordinates after the cut, and the place switched one frame before the position (a 1-frame pop).
lessons.root_cause: film_plan baked a place-entering act as a normal move (default move_s 0.5) keyed one frame after the body/place key
lessons.fix: film_plan.py: an act that enters another place lands on the same frame as the place switch (_land), no move

tests: tools/tests/test_production_intelligence.py :: PI-003 entering a place never slides
verification.regression_check: the test strips every move_s from place-entering acts and bakes: before the fix 4.52 m one-frame pop (lou f319) and 0.5 s slides; after 0.00 m

lessons.problem: Framing gates (head cut, figure size) measured figures that are not in the shot's place.
lessons.root_cause: the plan checker's framing loop ignored st.place while the renderer hides off-place figures
lessons.fix: film_plan.py framing loop skips a figure whose place differs from the camera's place

lessons.problem: A wide white haze over the night river.
lessons.root_cause: the moon key light glinted on the reflective water toward the camera and the bloom spread it (found by zeroing light groups one by one)
lessons.fix: night key light placed on the camera side; water specularIntensity lowered; reflection kept through the env map
lessons.notes: scene-specific; promote only when seen in a second film

lessons.problem: Characters placed inside a hero object's footprint (lifters inside the hull) and the object floating above their hands.
lessons.root_cause: positions chosen by eye in plan space without the object's measured footprint and contact height
lessons.fix: compute the object's footprint in plan space (rotation included) and stage contacts on its sides; check with tools/frame_checks/check.mjs body_in_mesh

tests: node tools/frame_checks/check.mjs episodes/ghost-army/film.json (0 body_in_mesh FAIL in the hook)
verification.regression_check: frame checks report the old staging as body_in_mesh FAIL (tank_track) and the new one clean
